text:
Situation: Liraglutide injection has been on FDA's shortage list since 2023-07-18 and was updated 2026-10-14. As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has lasted 39 months. The list includes Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc., Meitheal Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Novo Nordisk, Inc., and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. (To Be Discontinued). Teva's related information states discontinuation of the manufacture of the drug. Current stock: Corvale East holds two lots totaling 64 syringes covering 4.4 and 12.1 days; Corvale General holds 62 syringes covering 14 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows liraglutide injection as Current with an initial posting date of 2023-07-18 and an update on 2026-10-14. The listed manufacturers are Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc., Meitheal Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Novo Nordisk, Inc., and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. (To Be Discontinued). Teva's related information states discontinuation of the manufacture of the drug.

Our position: Supply from listed manufacturers remains unreliable. Teva is discontinuing manufacture. On-hand inventory provides less than three weeks of coverage across sites. Alternative suppliers not on FDA's shortage list exist but their labels name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate Biocon Pharma Inc. product for purchase; requires P&T committee approval before ordering.
2. Buyer to evaluate Cipla USA Inc. product for purchase; requires P&T committee approval before ordering.
3. Buyer to evaluate Hybio Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (Pingshan Factory) product for purchase; requires P&T committee approval before ordering.
4. Buyer to evaluate Lupin Pharmaceuticals, Inc. product for purchase; requires P&T committee approval before ordering.
5. Buyer to evaluate NorthStar Rx LLC product for purchase; requires P&T committee approval before ordering.

Not recommended: No action that assumes continued supply from Teva or that delays securing alternative sources.
